WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::BIGINT AS appointment_id,
        $2::TEXT AS clinic_name,
        $3::TEXT AS mobile
),

clinic_context AS (
    SELECT
        c.id AS clinic_id,
        c.name AS clinic_name,
        c.timezone
    FROM clinics c
    INNER JOIN request_data r
        ON c.name = r.clinic_name
    WHERE c.is_active = TRUE
    ORDER BY c.id
    LIMIT 1
),

patient_context AS (
    SELECT
        p.id AS patient_id,
        p.full_name AS patient_name,
        p.mobile
    FROM patients p
    INNER JOIN clinic_context c
        ON c.clinic_id = p.clinic_id
    INNER JOIN request_data r
        ON p.mobile = r.mobile
    ORDER BY p.id
    LIMIT 1
),

appointment_context AS (
    SELECT
        a.id AS appointment_id,
        a.status,
        a.starts_at,
        a.ends_at,
        a.google_calendar_event_id,

        c.clinic_name,
        c.timezone,

        p.patient_name,
        p.mobile,

        d.full_name AS doctor_name,
        s.name AS service_name

    FROM appointments a

    INNER JOIN clinic_context c
        ON c.clinic_id = a.clinic_id

    INNER JOIN patient_context p
        ON p.patient_id = a.patient_id

    INNER JOIN doctors d
        ON d.id = a.doctor_id

    LEFT JOIN services s
        ON s.id = a.service_id

    INNER JOIN request_data r
        ON r.appointment_id = a.id
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_context) THEN FALSE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM patient_context) THEN FALSE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM appointment_context) THEN FALSE
        WHEN (SELECT status FROM appointment_context) = 'cancelled' THEN FALSE
        WHEN (SELECT status FROM appointment_context) NOT IN ('pending', 'confirmed') THEN FALSE
        WHEN (SELECT ends_at FROM appointment_context) <= NOW() THEN FALSE
        ELSE TRUE
    END AS ready_to_cancel,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_context)
            THEN 'clinic_not_found'
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM patient_context)
            THEN 'patient_not_found'
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM appointment_context)
            THEN 'appointment_not_found'
        WHEN (SELECT status FROM appointment_context) = 'cancelled'
            THEN 'already_cancelled'
        WHEN (SELECT status FROM appointment_context) NOT IN ('pending', 'confirmed')
            THEN 'appointment_not_cancellable'
        WHEN (SELECT ends_at FROM appointment_context) <= NOW()
            THEN 'appointment_in_past'
        ELSE 'can_cancel'
    END AS result,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinic_context)
            THEN 'کلینیک مطابق ورودی پیدا نشد.'
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM patient_context)
            THEN 'بیماری با این شماره موبایل در کلینیک پیدا نشد.'
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM appointment_context)
            THEN 'این نوبت برای بیمار موردنظر پیدا نشد.'
        WHEN (SELECT status FROM appointment_context) = 'cancelled'
            THEN 'این نوبت قبلاً لغو شده است.'
        WHEN (SELECT status FROM appointment_context) NOT IN ('pending', 'confirmed')
            THEN 'وضعیت فعلی نوبت اجازه لغو خودکار را نمی‌دهد.'
        WHEN (SELECT ends_at FROM appointment_context) <= NOW()
            THEN 'این نوبت مربوط به گذشته است و قابل لغو نیست.'
        ELSE 'نوبت آماده لغو است.'
    END AS message,

    (
        SELECT appointment_id
        FROM appointment_context
    ) AS appointment_id,

    (
        SELECT patient_name
        FROM appointment_context
    ) AS patient_name,

    (
        SELECT doctor_name
        FROM appointment_context
    ) AS doctor_name,

    (
        SELECT service_name
        FROM appointment_context
    ) AS service_name,

    (
        SELECT TO_CHAR(
            starts_at AT TIME ZONE timezone,
            'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'
        )
        FROM appointment_context
    ) AS appointment_start,

    (
        SELECT status
        FROM appointment_context
    ) AS current_status,

    (
        SELECT google_calendar_event_id
        FROM appointment_context
    ) AS google_calendar_event_id

FROM request_data;

WITH updated_appointment AS (
    UPDATE appointments a
    SET
        status = 'cancelled',
        cancellation_reason = $4,
        cancelled_at = NOW(),
        updated_at = NOW()

    FROM clinics c, patients p

    WHERE a.id = $1
      AND c.id = a.clinic_id
      AND c.name = $2
      AND p.id = a.patient_id
      AND p.mobile = $3
      AND a.status IN ('pending', 'confirmed')
      AND a.ends_at > NOW()

    RETURNING
        a.id,
        a.clinic_id,
        a.doctor_id,
        a.patient_id,
        a.service_id,
        a.starts_at,
        a.ends_at,
        a.status,
        a.cancellation_reason,
        a.cancelled_at,
        a.google_calendar_event_id
)

SELECT
    TRUE AS success,
    'cancelled' AS result,
    'نوبت با موفقیت لغو شد.' AS message,

    ua.id AS appointment_id,
    p.full_name AS patient_name,
    p.mobile,
    d.full_name AS doctor_name,
    s.name AS service_name,

    TO_CHAR(
        ua.starts_at AT TIME ZONE c.timezone,
        'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'
    ) AS appointment_start,

    ua.status,
    ua.cancellation_reason,
    ua.cancelled_at,
    ua.google_calendar_event_id

FROM updated_appointment ua

INNER JOIN clinics c
    ON c.id = ua.clinic_id

INNER JOIN patients p
    ON p.id = ua.patient_id

INNER JOIN doctors d
    ON d.id = ua.doctor_id

LEFT JOIN services s
    ON s.id = ua.service_id

UNION ALL

SELECT
    FALSE AS success,
    'cancellation_conflict' AS result,
    'نوبت در فاصله بررسی تا لغو تغییر کرده است. لطفاً دوباره وضعیت نوبت را بررسی کنید.' AS message,

    NULL::BIGINT AS appointment_id,
    NULL::TEXT AS patient_name,
    NULL::TEXT AS mobile,
    NULL::TEXT AS doctor_name,
    NULL::TEXT AS service_name,
    NULL::TEXT AS appointment_start,
    NULL::TEXT AS status,
    NULL::TEXT AS cancellation_reason,
    NULL::TIMESTAMPTZ AS cancelled_at,
    NULL::TEXT AS google_calendar_event_id

WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM updated_appointment
);
